title: Zero erasures change nothing
statement: For every data tape $d : \mathbb{Z} \to \mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and integer $\ell$, erasing the cells in the interval $[\ell,\ell)$ leaves $d$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ assigns an optional Boolean value to each integer cell
replaced:
For every data tape $d$ and integer $\ell$, erasing the first zero cells of the interval
starting at $\ell$ yields $d$ unchanged.
